sections.title: Sound of -mb
paragraphs: The letters -mb sound like /m/. You hear this in (lamb) /læm/, which means lamb. The letters make only one sound.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Close both lips together gently. Let air flow out through your nose. Turn on your voice box. Place a hand on your throat to feel it buzz.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: The letters -mb appear at the end of a word or root. The second letter stays completely silent. The ending sounds as the sound /m/ in (comb) /koʊm/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not pronounce the final consonant as a separate sound. Keep your lips closed quietly at the end. Do not pop your lips open as you finish the word.
